name: logisim-mcp
description: Logisim-evolution 数字电路设计插件：13 个 MCP 工具覆盖「查几何 → 声明式生成 → 静态体检 → 网表仿真 → Logisim 真值表复核 → 经验沉淀」全链路。布线器按 5.0 源码几何自动走线，不使用隧道；生成的文件可直接在 Logisim 里打开仿真。适用于门级作业、计数器/寄存器/加法器搭建、以及「不许用现成芯片」这类限制。
description_en: Logisim-evolution circuit design plugin: 13 MCP tools covering geometry lookup, declarative generation with maze routing, static netlist audit, cycle-accurate simulation, Logisim truth-table cross-check, and a growing pitfall knowledge base.
